name: RECARO Aircraft Seating Americas
subject: Overflow sewing and leather repair for your seat shop
body:
Hi Recaro team,

I'm Dillon with Lerega, an upholstery and leather repair shop in Lakeway, near Austin. We repair, recolor and reupholster leather and vinyl seats, including aircraft seats around Austin.

We'd like to work as an overflow subcontractor for your seat or cabin shop: sewing dress covers to your patterns with your approved, burn-certified materials, and repairing or re-dyeing leather, under your repair station's quality system and inspection. Could you pass this to your Fort Worth repair station or purchasing team?

name: City of Round Rock Fleet (police, fire)
subject: Seat repair for patrol cars and emergency vehicles
body:
Hi Round Rock Purchasing team,

I'm Dillon with Lerega, an upholstery and leather repair shop in Lakeway. We repair and reupholster seats in patrol cars, fire trucks and ambulances: driver seats worn through by duty belts, torn bench seats and captain's chairs, flattened foam. We recently rebuilt a police vehicle seat in Round Rock in heavy top-grain leather and reshaped the right bolster so the duty belt doesn't wear it out.

Most seats can be repaired for much less than a new seat or cover, and we can come to your shop so the vehicle stays in service. Could you pass this to whoever handles seat repairs for the police and fire fleet, and let me know how to get set up as a vendor?

name: Texas State Preservation Board (Texas Capitol)
subject: Leather chair and furniture restoration
body:
Hi SPB procurement team,

I'm Dillon with Lerega, an upholstery and leather repair shop in Lakeway. We repair and reupholster seating in public buildings: courtroom, jury and gallery chairs, council chamber and office chairs, lobby benches. We fix torn vinyl and leather, worn and faded finishes and flattened cushions, and reupholster pieces that can't be saved. Most repairs are done on site, so the furniture doesn't leave the building.

We also restore antique leather furniture and keep the original leather where we can. Could you add us to the list for furniture and upholstery solicitations, and pass this to the Curator's office?
